review.method_name: Injection-locked dual-DFB photonic integrated-circuit heterodyne THz generator
experimental_conditions: Two monolithically integrated DFB lasers injection-locked by a mode-locked-laser optical frequency comb
44.43 GHz signal bandwidth and 10.7 m wireless transmission distance
14 dBm optical power in the reported high-speed experiment
main_results: The integrated source was tunable from 0 to 1.4 THz
A net rate of 131.21 Gbit/s was transmitted over 10.7 m at 0.4 THz
Optical injection locking improved tone OSNR by about 10 dB relative to the original comb
